headline.text: L1 missing evaporated milk forced schedule change; L2 broken bars at *16 per minute* still high after adjustments; L3 ML4 chiller faulting

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 3 cleared a 3-hour Russell Finex clog and pistachio buildup by midday and is running. Sollich 4 delayed ~1 hour on cold corn syrup but delivered caramel by 12:40. Sollich 2 labeling issues on Jar A persisted through window close despite roll changes. Missing 140 lbs evaporated milk for sugar-free caramel; ETA 12:30 from purchasing.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 broken bars counted at 16 per minute at 22:15; demolding hammers adjusted but no confirmation of improvement by window close. ML3 ran steady after belt-before-curve issue cleared in 4 minutes. FFS film broke twice, both cleared inside 30 minutes. Graham cookies staged for 3rd shift after 18:48 delivery.
per_plant_summary.L3: Truffle line replaced destroyed Cavanna 2 exit belt and worn roller; back online at 08:51 after 1-hour stop. ML4 chiller 2 faulting in protection mode, circuit 2 pressure issues unresolved at window close. ML1 PTL pressure spiking above 19 psi, chocolate flow stopping. Moulding ran steady aside from localized jams.

notes.text: Evaporated milk (10011) shortage traced to incorrect BOM; item not called in NetSuite WOs until December but needed today for sugar-free caramel trial.
Display version mismatch clarified: use V1 only until V2 approval received; CNC next if V1 runs out.
3rd shift left 15 molds stuck in north washroom; flagged for coaching.
